hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -q 'groupware-bot/.*\.py$'; then python3 -m py_compile "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>&1; elif MODULE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -oE '(common|clients|ingest|worker|scheduler|groupware)' | head -1) && [ -n "$MODULE" ]; then ./gradlew :$MODULE:compileJava --no-daemon -q 2>&1 | tail -5; fi
echo '❌ 컴파일 실패 — ./gradlew :모듈:compileJava --info 로 상세 확인'
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git push.*main'; then echo 'BLOCKED: main 직접 푸시 금지 — PR을 통해 merge' && exit 1; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -q 'google-credentials.json'; then echo 'BLOCKED: google-credentials.json은 민감 정보 — 읽기/수정 금지' && exit 1; fi
echo 'Lambda 제약: (1) Slack 응답 항상 200 (2) 3초 제한 → SQS 위임 (3) handleRequest() 리턴 후에만 HTTP 응답 (4) static volatile 캐싱 300ms+'

BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); ISSUE=$(echo "$BRANCH" | grep -oE '/([0-9]+)-' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | head -1); if [ -z "$ISSUE" ]; then ISSUE=$(echo "$BRANCH" | sed 's/issue-//'); fi; if [ -n "$ISSUE" ] && [ "$ISSUE" != "main" ]; then echo "브랜치: $BRANCH | 이슈: #$ISSUE"; gh issue view "$ISSUE" --json title,state -q '.title + " (" + .state + ")"' 2>/dev/null || true; fi
